shoal_e21_entry.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_entry.text: On Day Four Hundred, Yue completed the morning's ordinary receiving shift before attending the separate departure reassessment. The port school had accepted a new thirty-two-copper scope: ten for the qualified examiner, ten for the independent technical supervisor, six current materials, and six ordinary care. It was not a seventh-stage course. It would examine whether the existing small local task remained supportable after work, interruptions, and earlier injuries.

shoal_e21_preparation_02.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_preparation_02.text: The examiner read the actual old source ceiling aloud. Half-unit input over four ordinary breaths had qualified a quarter-unit useful marker task in a bounded stopped and grounded setup. Recovered throughput remained no more than one-eighth per breath. Six earned primary pairs did not automatically enlarge range, duration, load, or medical use. Yue supplied the current body record, including the old shoulder's waist-only limit and the elbow's recovered ordinary baseline.

shoal_e21_preparation_03.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_preparation_03.text: The supervisor independently checked the current marker equipment before letting Yue stand at its ordinary position. Its low load was weighed through the accepted local method. The stop and ground belonged to separate tested parts of the setup. A source record from months earlier could identify what to check and could not substitute for the actual present check. The examiner wanted the current task observed, not a recital of its history.

shoal_e21_preparation_04.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_preparation_04.text: Yue had brought the current mechanical review report within its permitted source scope. Its first format had exposed a different kind of ordinary uncertainty. A quiet bench and an actual work-position walkthrough taught different observations about fit and bodies. The examiner would ask her to identify what she had really learned from that source, leaving the unperformed method unclaimed. Her chosen review access would shape the first question.

shoal_e21_source_gate.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_source_gate.text: The examiner opened the first mechanical review's permitted report. It described the actual format Yue had organized and the different question left unobserved. Ordinary mechanical evidence could inform attention in a current practice setup. It could not qualify qi output, a medical task, or the unperformed observation by analogy. Yue would answer from the source she actually had.

shoal_e21_bench_01.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_bench_01.text: The quiet bench report described a repeated low-load hinge bind at measured angles and the replacement bolt that removed it within the tested scope. It also described Perru's work-position question as unobserved in that first window. Yue told the examiner both parts. The report could support a lesson about a small actual geometric mismatch. It could not prove that a busy worker's sleeve and handover were now qualified by the quiet bench result.

shoal_e21_bench_02.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_bench_02.text: The examiner asked where a current marker task might have its own analogous ordinary mismatch. Yue pointed to the contact seating, which the technical supervisor had already checked under the accepted method. She did not claim the hinge drawing belonged to her body's routes. The analogy helped her ask a current equipment question. Its answer still came from an independent actual check of this setup, with its own source and conditions.

shoal_e21_bench_03.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_bench_03.text: At the device table, a cloth edge lay closer to the stop handle than she preferred. She asked the supervisor to assess its actual clearance before input. The supervisor moved the ordinary cover within the accepted arrangement and rechecked the stop. That current correction was useful. It did not mean the earlier unperformed walkthrough had secretly occurred or that Yue now possessed a new field qualification because she had noticed cloth.

shoal_e21_bench_04.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_bench_04.text: Perru had not been offered a place at this reassessment through the quiet first review. The examiner had invited the currently available ordinary observers under this new finite scope. Yue could not quote an absent worker's private confidence in the marker task. She named the bench lesson and its limits, then turned to the actual people who would observe whether she could stop her own body when the present setup asked it.

shoal_e21_bench_05.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_bench_05.text: The examiner said a bench can make repeatable movement easier to see and can hide some demands of work outside it. Yue would need to retain both truths when carrying this qualification on a road. The existing marker task remained local and bounded. A calm room was one of its actual conditions, not proof that the same input would serve a crowded loading lane, a storm, or a frightened injured person.

shoal_e21_bench_06.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_bench_06.text: Yue placed the permitted mechanical report beside the current practice record and kept their source purposes separate. One documented an ordinary hinge repair. The other would document a body and marker application actually observed today. Her chosen bench access had sharpened one useful question and left a different observation absent. The examiner would now judge the present task, not reward her for having selected the quieter room.

shoal_e21_workwalk_01.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_workwalk_01.text: The work-position report described Perru's sleeve catch in an unfueled ordinary handover and the tab-route change that removed it in tested positions. It also left the detailed quiet hinge-angle question unobserved in that first window. Yue told the examiner both parts. The report could teach attention to an actual worker's reach. It could not certify every geometry or make a qualified qi application from an ordinary mechanical demonstration.

shoal_e21_workwalk_02.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_workwalk_02.text: The examiner asked what the current marker position required from Yue's own body. She identified the waist height, permitted reach, and clear stop access rather than assuming a table was suitable because it had held another person's device. The independent supervisor checked the actual arrangement against the current scope. Perru's demonstration supplied a useful question about bodies. This setup still needed its own answer from current observations.

shoal_e21_workwalk_03.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_workwalk_03.text: Perru had accepted a finite ordinary observer invitation through the new departure-assessment scope. She would offer only what she saw here, with no authority over Yue's internal routes. She asked whether Yue could reach the stop without twisting through the old shoulder limit. The examiner welcomed the practical question. Yue demonstrated the permitted ordinary motion without input, and the supervisor recorded the actual clearance before any measured task began.

shoal_e21_workwalk_04.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_workwalk_04.text: The demonstration did not qualify overhead catching, a live freight case, or medical work. Perru could see that and said she appreciated a report that named what a body was actually asked to do. She did not promise to endorse the marker task before it occurred. Yue had gained a particular observer relationship through the earlier work-position choice, and the observer retained her own right to remain uncertain.

shoal_e21_workwalk_05.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_workwalk_05.text: The examiner said actual work positions can expose ordinary interference and still fail to show every small geometric bind. Yue would need that boundary on the road too. Her first review had not performed the quiet repeated hinge comparison. The current supervisor therefore checked this marker's contact seating independently rather than borrow certainty from the lanyard fix. Different methods could supply useful evidence without becoming interchangeable.

shoal_e21_workwalk_06.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_workwalk_06.text: Yue placed the permitted walkthrough report beside the current practice record and kept their purposes separate. One documented an ordinary sleeve-clearance change. The other would document a body and marker application actually observed today. Her chosen access had brought a worker's question into the room and left a different observation absent. The examiner would judge the present task, not reward her for having chosen the crowded table.

shoal_e21_source_rejoin_01.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_source_rejoin_01.text: The examiner first reviewed the ordinary work that had continued around the reassessment. On Day Three Hundred Ninety-Eight, the review's third qualified twelve-copper session had examined a current case's ordinary stop-cover retention within its accepted scope. Its fuel stayed blocked. The owner received the actual findings and retained the unresolved questions outside that session. Thirty-six of the forty-eight assessment copper had now funded performed work.

shoal_e21_source_rejoin_02.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_source_rejoin_02.text: Yue had received that report during the first shift of her final five-day group. She had not operated the case with qi. Her ordinary receiving work could continue within actual clinical limits, while a body task required its own present evidence. The examiner wanted the distinction clear because diligent workers often began treating ordinary availability as a promise that every heavier task must also be possible that afternoon.

shoal_e21_source_rejoin_03.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_source_rejoin_03.text: The current marker equipment passed its independent ordinary calibration check. Its quarter-unit load and local distance matched the accepted setup. The stop worked without Yue's cooperation, and the ground route had its own tested condition. These were not formalities added after a successful performance. They were actual parts of the task that kept a failed performance from turning into someone else's uncontrolled problem.

shoal_e21_source_rejoin_04.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_source_rejoin_04.text: Yue stood at the permitted waist position and checked touch before input. The old shoulder remained inside its ordinary range. She reported her current fatigue instead of calling a long workday evidence of improved endurance. The examiner had allowed a bounded trial if present checks supported it. He would stop it if the observed body or measured setup moved outside that support. The afternoon would not become more successful by redefining the limit after she crossed it.

shoal_e21_source_rejoin_05.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_source_rejoin_05.text: The first ordinary breath admitted the measured portion of the allowed source. Yue kept attention on the small marker rather than on the observing faces. The second brought a delayed tightening in her forefinger before the complete four-breath task. She reported it as soon as she recognized it. The independent examiner stopped the input at the actual recorded quarter-unit admitted, with the intended marker task incomplete.

shoal_e21_source_rejoin_06.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_source_rejoin_06.text: The supervisor grounded the remainder through the tested route. Recovered throughput stayed within one-eighth per ordinary breath and was measured across its actual discharge, not claimed as an instant perfect return. No useful quarter-unit task was certified from the interrupted attempt. Yue remained standing at waist height while the setup became quiet. The stop had worked independently, which was one actual success inside a failed present performance.

shoal_e21_source_rejoin_07.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_source_rejoin_07.text: She wanted to say the tightening was slight. The examiner agreed that its degree belonged in the record and refused to let slight mean unreported. The current task had been interrupted before its intended completion. That was enough to suspend another same-day attempt. They did not need to wait for a dramatic injury before taking a present change seriously. Yue accepted the ordinary restriction while still wishing she had finished.

shoal_e21_source_rejoin_08.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_source_rejoin_08.text: The examiner asked when she had noticed the first sensation. She described the actual sequence and the uncertainty between expecting a feeling and recognizing one. He recorded her account beside his independent stop observation. The task did not require an imaginary flawless perception. It required early enough reporting and a stop that did not depend on her proving she never made a mistake. Today's report would make that practical boundary more visible.

shoal_e21_source_rejoin_09.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_source_rejoin_09.text: At home, Yue found it hardest to write incomplete beside a task she had already once qualified. A past qualification remained a past fact. A current interruption remained a current fact. Six earned pairs were not erased by one stopped attempt, and neither did they protect every future afternoon from fatigue or symptoms. She wrote the measured input, stop, and unfinished output before writing how disappointed she felt.

shoal_e21_source_rejoin_10.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_source_rejoin_10.text: On Day Four Hundred One, the ordinary clinician performed the first accepted two-copper assessment from the six-copper care line. Current examination found no basis to declare a new load safe. The plan restricted powered attempts until actual recovery review and kept ordinary receiving within suitable no-load conditions. Yue received warning signs and a named return date. The clinician did not certify internal route expansion or promise that the symptom could never return.

shoal_e21_source_rejoin_11.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_source_rejoin_11.text: She went to the next permitted ordinary shift with a suitable writing arrangement and actual breaks under the clinical guidance. Han would have accepted a stop if needed. She did not haul cases, demonstrate qi, or make the office's usefulness a reason to ignore the care instructions. Her four-hour task received other people's findings and required ordinary attention. It could be meaningful work while a different task remained paused.

shoal_e21_source_rejoin_12.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_source_rejoin_12.text: The qualified assessor preparing the fourth mechanical review asked whether Lin intended to supply its source power. Han showed the actual ordinary scope and blocked fuel. No such contribution belonged in the task. The assessor was relieved because a local current cover check did not need a visitor's body method. Its own setup and ordinary tools supplied the appropriate evidence. Lin's interrupted marker attempt stayed in the separate reassessment record.

shoal_e21_source_rejoin_13.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_source_rejoin_13.text: On Day Four Hundred Two, the fourth twelve-copper mechanical assessment actually examined the accepted final ordinary closing sequence and its identified stop within the bounded review. The assessor could finish its present question and retain unperformed methods as unresolved. Neither owner's whole device acquired a live field qualification. All forty-eight assessor copper had now been spent on four actual scoped sessions.

shoal_e21_source_rejoin_14.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_source_rejoin_14.text: The review's twelve-copper messages completed their accepted receiving and dispatch for the actual owners and final findings. The twenty-copper materials line had already funded performed items under the selected first method. No additional private parts were hidden inside it. With the eighty labor line pending its last payment, the one-hundred-sixty source contained completed work and one actual wage due, not a new surplus for Lin's practice care.

shoal_e21_source_rejoin_15.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_source_rejoin_15.text: Yue completed the final ordinary four-hour shift that day under the current clinical limits. Twenty actual shifts had now been performed in the accepted four groups. Their source would close the next day. She returned the owners' temporary materials under their actual custody terms and kept pending questions clearly identified. Finishing a finite appointment did not mean every device problem had been solved. It meant the promised work had been done.

shoal_e21_source_rejoin_16.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_source_rejoin_16.text: On Day Four Hundred Three, the second two-copper clinical assessment compared current touch and grip with the ordinary baseline and reviewed the leg and shoulder limits relevant to the permitted stance. The forefinger change had resolved under the current ordinary plan. No overhead shoulder clearance or new range was declared. The clinician allowed a rested bounded return to the old application only under its own qualified setup and independent stop.

shoal_e21_source_rejoin_17.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_source_rejoin_17.text: The ordinary clinical recovery was real enough to matter and narrow enough to retain. Yue wanted the record to say ready. The clinician wrote the actual allowed conditions instead. Ready for what was the question. She could understand the answer better after watching mechanical owners turn a successful local repair into a hope that the whole device was now safe in every weather. Her body deserved the same precision she wanted for their cases.

shoal_e21_source_rejoin_18.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_source_rejoin_18.text: The final twenty-copper wage reached Yue after closure on Day Four Hundred Three. All eighty from the new ordinary review had now been earned and paid. The source closed one hundred sixty actually spent: eighty labor, forty-eight qualified assessments, twenty materials, twelve messages. It left no unused institution money in her pocket. Her own present savings and earnings could fund remaining room, meals, and later ordinary road needs.

shoal_e21_source_rejoin_19.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_source_rejoin_19.text: Han returned her temporary work key and then took it back properly because the room belonged to the office, not to the worker who had used it longest that month. Yue laughed at the momentary confusion and handed it over. A familiar object could feel personal while remain institutional property. She took her own notebook, the permitted report, and the current next appointment time. None required a claim on the cupboard.

shoal_e21_source_rejoin_20.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_source_rejoin_20.text: On Day Four Hundred Four, she rested from powered work and completed only her own ordinary errands. The rest was not empty. She washed clothing, mended a small pocket, and bought food within her actual money. She took a public walk short enough for the current shoulder and elbow guidance. A day with no measured output could support a later task without pretending it had already produced one.

shoal_e21_source_rejoin_21.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_source_rejoin_21.text: At Bo's shop, the apprentice was teaching a younger visitor how to identify several ordinary fastenings. Bo had accepted that teaching hour as part of paid work and remained in his seated role. The visitor thought the smallest pieces least important. Bo asked which missing piece would let a handle detach under load. The lesson was practical and did not claim every small error would become a disaster. Some merely wasted time, which workers also cared about.

shoal_e21_source_rejoin_22.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_source_rejoin_22.text: Jin asked whether Yue's failed reassessment had changed her road plans. Yue said no role had been accepted, and the application still needed its actual current proof before she carried it as qualified. Jin appreciated an answer that did not conceal disappointment. Bo said he was tired of being compared with a body he had possessed before the fire. Yue thought of her own best past marker attempt and understood a little more than before.

shoal_e21_source_rejoin_23.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_source_rejoin_23.text: That evening she practiced no new route and rehearsed no imagined great circuit. Her six pairs remained the earned current stage. Opening more pairs somewhere in a future course would still require actual compatible work, failure, recovery, and independent evidence. Tonight the task was to sleep and arrive with a body that had been assessed rather than with a story about how much she wanted to deserve a larger one.

shoal_e21_source_rejoin_24.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_source_rejoin_24.text: On Day Four Hundred Five, the examiner and independent supervisor calibrated the current marker setup again after the rested interval. A check performed on Four Hundred did not certify every component forever. They measured the local load and source allowance, tested independent stop and ground, and confirmed the permitted ordinary stance. Yue reported current symptoms and the actual recovery review before approaching the input.

shoal_e21_source_rejoin_25.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_source_rejoin_25.text: The trial began with no promise of a larger task. Four ordinary breaths admitted no more than the known half-unit input. The local marker completed its quarter-unit useful movement within the qualified bounded distance and load. The supervisor observed the cost and remaining source separately. Yue did not push for another movement because the marker looked easy at the end. Completion was the place to stop, not a reason to invent an extension.

shoal_e21_source_rejoin_26.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_source_rejoin_26.text: The independent stop ended input after the accepted task, and the tested ground handled the remaining source under measured conditions. Recovered throughput stayed no more than one-eighth per breath. The record did not describe a perfect lossless cycle. It described actual input, useful output, stop, discharge, and recovery rate. Those figures held the application to its existing local scale, where its usefulness and limits could both be examined.

shoal_e21_source_rejoin_27.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_source_rejoin_27.text: The examiner compared the actual trial with the interrupted attempt. Today's rested conditions and current recovery review had supported the same bounded task. They did not prove a cure for every future tightening or qualification after any workload. The failed attempt remained in the report beside the success. Yue would carry a more honest current record rather than a brighter one stripped of the day that had stopped.

shoal_e21_source_rejoin_28.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_source_rejoin_28.text: An observer asked whether the success meant she was approaching the seventh stage. The examiner said this was no seventh-stage examination. It reassessed an existing small application at stage six under its current conditions. The next stage would require its own registered standards, qualified teaching, failures, recovery, and evidence. Lin's present half-unit task had not earned a new circuit by being successfully repeated.

shoal_e21_source_rejoin_29.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_source_rejoin_29.text: Yue was embarrassed at how relieved she felt about a task that had not grown at all. The examiner said reliability could be valuable without being advancement. She had wanted a proof that the port's interruptions had not changed her. Instead she had proof that a present body could do a narrow thing after actual care and rest, with a prior failed afternoon still true. That was enough to be useful and enough to require caution.

shoal_e21_source_rejoin_30.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_source_rejoin_30.text: The supervisor returned the practice apparatus to its proper school custody after its condition check. Yue received the actual permitted assessment record, not the marker equipment. Her own practice notebook could describe the measured task under its source terms. The office would retain its own original. A successful application did not make a device hers or establish a right to carry its material into an unaccepted road appointment.

shoal_e21_source_rejoin_31.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_source_rejoin_31.text: On Day Four Hundred Six, the final two-copper care visit compared next-day touch, grip, and leg condition with the accepted ordinary baseline and reviewed the shoulder's ongoing limit. The permitted findings supported the performed local trial without clearing overhead catch or broader duration. Six care copper had now paid three actual visits. The examiner's next-day check also remained in its accepted fee scope and matched the recorded ordinary course.

shoal_e21_source_rejoin_32.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_source_rejoin_32.text: The thirty-two-copper reassessment source closed on performed work: ten examiner, ten independent technical supervision, six materials, six care. The current record held the interrupted Four Hundred attempt, actual recovery, rested Four Hundred Five task, and next-day findings. Lin remained at Qi Gathering six. There was no new realm, medical application, or power over a harbor wall hidden in the closing account.

shoal_e21_source_rejoin_33.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_source_rejoin_33.text: She sent the actual current application record to the ordinary road receiving clerk under its permitted scope. The old shoulder restriction appeared plainly enough that an employer planning heavy overhead work could decline her for that role. She did not call such a refusal unfair in advance. A suitable appointment would need work her body and qualified method could actually perform, along with the ordinary skills and hours she was willing to offer.

shoal_e21_source_rejoin_34.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_source_rejoin_34.text: On Day Four Hundred Seven, the association invited her to read three different proposed road arrangements. Each would begin after her port departure and have a finite receiving task at the mine. Cargo escort, consenting workers' journey, and independent survey were different jobs with different property and people. Her renewed small marker qualification was background information, not their power supply. She asked for the actual owners, dates, and costs before imagining which one she wanted.

shoal_e21_source_rejoin_35.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_source_rejoin_35.text: The invitation did not reopen her completed port wages or make a funded road a gift without work. It supplied three accepted scopes she could consider. She would carry her own pack in every case. Anything else needed a named lender or consenting traveler. Sui would check ordinary departure conditions whichever route she selected. Lin's body had earned no exemption from the entry and custody requirements of the next town.

shoal_e21_source_rejoin_36.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_source_rejoin_36.text: At supper she considered how much she liked being asked to carry tools rather than people. Tools had owners who could speak through terms, but their needs were less likely to change mid-road. People could refuse, become homesick, disagree, or decide a town was not for them. A cargo role might offer a supplier bench and fewer household accounts. A worker journey might offer trust and no supplier equipment. A survey might offer independent questions and borrowed instruments due back on a date.

shoal_e21_source_rejoin_37.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_source_rejoin_37.text: She wrote no answer that evening. The offers would remain open until the accepted reply time on Day Four Hundred Nine. Her actual money could support a refusal of all new roles if she chose a separately funded ordinary road from her own means, but it did not make every path equally convenient. The proposed scopes had material gains and duties. She wanted the decision to come from those actual differences, after sleeping.

shoal_e21_source_rejoin_38.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_source_rejoin_38.text: On Day Four Hundred Eight, Yue walked the harbor's ordinary boundary one more time with Sui. The captain checked the current departure application and asked whether Lin had arranged her remaining lodging through the date she intended to leave. She had paid the actual current stay from own money. The next role remained undecided. Sui said she preferred an honest blank line to an invented employer who would be blamed later for a promise nobody had accepted.

shoal_e21_source_rejoin_39.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_source_rejoin_39.text: At the seawall, ordinary waves struck ordinary stone. The repaired local freight station still needed its separately fueled components, staff, and current permitted work. Lin could offer no infinite quiet to the water. She leaned on the public rail within her body's ordinary limits and watched a boat turn toward the channel under its crew's skill. The view was enough for this morning. The next afternoon would ask her to choose a concrete road.

shoal_e21_source_rejoin_40.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_source_rejoin_40.text: Back in her room, she put the current stage-six record beside the three offered terms. One told an employer what narrow powered task remained qualified. The others told Lin what actual ordinary work and company each road would require. Neither answered for the other. She folded her clean clothes into her own pack, leaving space only for property she might later receive under a role she had truly accepted.

shoal_e21_room_01.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_room_01.text: The examiner asked the ordinary keeper to close one shutter against the glare, not because darkness improved cultivation but because the marker's small movement needed to be seen consistently. The keeper chose a position that left the ordinary exit clear and enough light on the stop. Yue watched that modest change improve the room's evidence. A useful setting could be built through several people's knowledge instead of one gifted person's intuition.

shoal_e21_room_02.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_room_02.text: An observer wanted to stand nearer the marker. The supervisor gave the actual permitted position and explained the view available there. The observer moved as asked. A second person could see the source scale better from the opposite side. Their accounts would overlap without being identical. Yue liked knowing they would not later have to pretend everyone had seen every part. She also found it harder to perform under several accurately limited eyes.

shoal_e21_room_03.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_room_03.text: The supervisor showed the actual scale reading before input and asked the observers to name what it measured. One guessed output. It measured admitted source here, while the useful task had its own separate observation. The error was corrected before the trial. No one was mocked for asking. A person could watch carefully and still need the instrument's purpose explained, which was why the current setup included a skilled independent supervisor.

shoal_e21_room_04.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_room_04.text: The examiner checked the route practice record Yue offered. It showed six earned primary pairs under prior witnessed work and no newly claimed circuit. He asked which daily practice she had actually sustained during the port's ordinary labor weeks. She named the modest accepted exercises and interruptions, including days of clinical restriction. She would not turn work attendance into hidden uninterrupted cultivation. The examiner accepted the history for what it could actually establish.

shoal_e21_room_05.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_room_05.text: One apprentice watching the room said he would have practiced through the restriction to avoid losing time. His teacher asked whether he wanted advice or applause for a task he had not performed. He became quiet, then asked about recovery. The examiner answered the current general distinction between rest and qualification without using Lin's private care as a lesson she had not offered. Yue was glad the boy could ask before learning through his own unnecessary injury.

shoal_e21_room_06.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_room_06.text: The current care terms included actual ordinary visits if indicated within their accepted scope. The clinician was not waiting behind the wall to erase any consequence. The source bought access to defined skilled work, not a guarantee. Yue felt better knowing what help existed and remained cautious knowing what it could not promise. Preparation could make a task reasonable without making her body invulnerable to a change the room had not predicted.

shoal_e21_room_07.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_room_07.text: She adjusted her plain sleeve before standing at the marked position. The cloth had no special property; it simply needed to stay clear of the movement. The examiner asked whether she wanted another ordinary minute before beginning. She took it. Nobody treated the pause as a weaker stage. She used it to check where her feet were and whether her breath felt ordinary, rather than rehearsing the look of success in the observers' faces.

shoal_e21_room_08.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_room_08.text: At the doorway, a clerk quietly received another person's application for a later course. The work continued without making Lin's present task the whole school's purpose. Yue could hear a question about lodging dates and an answer about current prices. It reminded her that every qualification sat inside ordinary lives requiring rooms, food, and people whose labor had its own terms. Her marker did not stand outside that world merely because its input was measured.

shoal_e21_room_09.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_room_09.text: The examiner asked whether she still wanted to attempt the current bounded task under the reported fatigue and existing checks. She said yes, knowing that yes did not bind her to continue through a new symptom. Consent to begin was not a promise that the source would run for all four breaths whatever happened. The independent stop retained its actual authority. The room became quiet as the supervisor signaled that current preparation was complete.

shoal_e21_room_10.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_room_10.text: Yue noticed how much she wanted the quiet to last. Out on the quay, work came with interruptions and demands to hurry. Here the task had deliberately bounded conditions. Carrying its result on the road would mean carrying those conditions too. She could want greater range in the future and still be honest about this room. The examiner nodded when she named the local setup, and the present trial could begin.

shoal_e21_days_01.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_days_01.text: After the current reassessment closed, Yue found the school corridor fuller than when she had entered. Ordinary students were waiting for different courses, some younger than she had been at her first attempt. One asked whether a failed day meant losing every previous lesson. She said his actual teacher should answer for his course. She could tell him only that her own record retained earlier work beside a stopped present attempt.

shoal_e21_days_02.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_days_02.text: The student wanted the stopped attempt removed from her story because it made success less exciting. Yue said it made her next employer better informed. He looked unconvinced. Another student said excitement was not a good loading plan. They argued on the ordinary corridor bench while their teacher prepared the next room. Yue left them with their current question and no invented future in which the more sensible child inevitably became wiser.

shoal_e21_days_03.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_days_03.text: At the public market, she bought ordinary necessities within her small personal allowance. Since arriving, the extra cups, modest meal shares, greens, flowers, ticket, and minor household purchases had together cost no more than sixteen copper outside her regular room-and-meal rate. She kept the actual receipts and small notes rather than charging the pleasant parts of the stay to a care source. Enjoyment deserved its own honest place in her purse.

shoal_e21_days_04.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_days_04.text: The new eighty-copper ordinary wage had given her more room to plan the long road. She still wanted a reserve for provisions and any personal lodging not covered by an accepted carrier. A funded role might reduce some costs and add actual obligations. She could read both sides without calling the offered travel free. Her own money made refusal possible; it did not make refusal consequence-free or every road equally easy.

shoal_e21_days_05.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_days_05.text: Rong Sui met her outside his supplier room and asked whether her current task had grown stronger. She described the same bounded marker application and its actual reassessment. He looked disappointed because he had hoped a stronger local source might simplify a freight design. She asked which qualified device he meant. He admitted the idea was still a proposal. His hope could be commercially useful and still need real work before anyone relied on it.

shoal_e21_days_06.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_days_06.text: He offered her an ordinary cup of tea in the public receiving corner, not access to the closed supplier bench. She accepted within the offered hour. They spoke about prices and a shipment that had finally arrived through its actual route. Rong had lost trade during delays and made some new sales afterward. Neither cancelled the other. He wanted future work that paid, and she wanted terms that did not make her body its unlimited reserve.

shoal_e21_days_07.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_days_07.text: He said her questions made negotiations slower. She said unsupported assumptions had also made receiving slower after the fire. He conceded the point without becoming fond of every restriction. They could disagree and still enjoy decent tea. Yue had once imagined that finding a clear account would settle a person's character. Rong remained more difficult and more ordinary than that, a man capable of a correct refusal and an inconvenient demand in the same afternoon.

shoal_e21_days_08.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_days_08.text: At He Ming's household, a cousin had returned from a short actual road visit with stories about relatives the public office would never know. He Ming asked Yue to stay for a brief ordinary greeting when she passed. She accepted and kept the visit separate from any witness role. The cousin wanted to know whether harbor rents were still too high. Everyone answered at once, which made the household more useful company than a clean official summary.

shoal_e21_days_09.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_days_09.text: A younger relative asked about the mine's stones. Yue said she had not yet been there on this road and could not tell him current conditions. He produced a pebble he wanted her to identify. She could see its ordinary shape and knew no qualified mineral test that would make a confident answer appropriate. He decided to keep it because it looked like a fish. That use required no certification she had failed to supply.

shoal_e21_days_10.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_days_10.text: He Ming later walked with her to the public corner. He wanted a broader worker procedure proposed before another supplier's wages became uncertain. She asked who had accepted the work of drafting it. Several workers had offered finite hours, and Han could receive the current proposal during his actual office time. It would continue without Lin's presence. Hearing that made leaving easier, even though she liked being useful in the room.

shoal_e21_days_11.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_days_11.text: At Bo's shop, the apprentice had received an offer of more hours elsewhere. Bo was sad and discussed the actual ending of their current paid scope rather than pretending the young man owed him loyalty forever. The apprentice would finish the agreed week before departing. Jin asked whether a different limited helper might fit their narrower business. No candidate had accepted yet. The household would need to plan with that uncertainty still real.

shoal_e21_days_12.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_days_12.text: Yue found the conversation hard to watch because departure was becoming a repeated ordinary fact around her. The apprentice wanted to go and regretted leaving Bo with less help. Both feelings mattered. He asked whether he could visit when his new hours permitted. Bo said yes under an actual invitation, not as a disguised return to unpaid work. They shook hands over the completed current terms and left future visits to future days.

shoal_e21_days_13.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_days_13.text: On the walk home, a public carpenter was repairing a rail with proper permission and ordinary barriers. Yue used the open side of the lane. She would not test the new rail with energy or make an overhead catch if another person leaned carelessly on the unfinished section. The carpenter's clear boundary and pedestrians' ordinary cooperation did the present work. A town could be safer because many people kept small actual instructions.

shoal_e21_days_14.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_days_14.text: That night she dreamed of the marker moving farther than its qualified distance. In the dream the room applauded and the examiner remained silent. Waking, she felt how tempting a silent examiner could be. She opened the actual record and read the local quarter-unit task again. The page did not applaud. It told her what had occurred, including the stop and measured cost, which was more useful for tomorrow's road question.

shoal_e21_days_15.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_days_15.text: She put the record away before breakfast. A familiar stage label could describe earned work and still fail to answer whether a proposed job suited her present body. The next offer would need ordinary hours, owners, travel, and a task she could actually perform. Yue ate a proper meal already covered by her current lodging rate, then went to hear the association's three concrete proposals instead of asking a dream to choose among them.

shoal_e21_days_16.speaker: narrator
shoal_e21_days_16.text: Outside, the apprentice passed carrying his own tools to the new employer's actual interview. Yue wished him well without asking him to remain. He waved cheerfully, then hurried because that receiving hour belonged to someone else's paid morning.
